authority.label: Areas of Professional Expertise
authority.strategyDescription: From the problem to a clear choice

about.imageAlt: A professional workspace and discussion setting; sample image
about.quote: A good strategy defines the right problem before it provides an answer.
about.verticalLabel: A POINT OF VIEW, NOT JUST A SERVICE
about.paragraph1: Brands and businesses endure when scattered decisions are connected by a clear logic. My approach focuses on understanding the problem, seeing the relationships between its parts, and turning analysis into actionable choices.
about.paragraph2: At the intersection of academia and professional practice, I aim to turn strategic concepts into practical tools for managers, entrepreneurs, and business teams.

expertise.titleStart: To build distinction, you need to see
expertise.description: Each discipline approaches a problem from a different angle. Real value emerges when these perspectives work together.
expertise.brandStrategyDescription: Clarifying positioning, value proposition, and the meaning a brand should create in its audience's mind.
expertise.brandArchitectureDescription: Designing the relationships between a master brand, sub-brands, products, and an organization's portfolio of offerings.
expertise.businessDesignDescription: Aligning customer problems, value creation models, and the key decisions that drive growth.
